title: IR1005 ordering description repeats IR1001
detail: Table 11 lists the IR1005-G2 SKU under IR1005 routers but its description says IR1001-G2. Identity uses the SKU column and the distinct Table 2 comparison. Do not copy the description as IR1005 specifications.

title: IE3505 PoE ordering table duplicates the -A PID
detail: Table 3 lists -E and -A variants, while Table 21 repeats IE-3505-8P3S-A against both Essential and Advantage descriptions. These variants are withheld from the starter catalog pending clarification.
resolution: Unambiguous IE-3505-8T3S-E/-A ordering rows are now published; the duplicated PoE -A row remains unresolved and those PoE variants are withheld.

title: Meraki plus on-device security coexistence is unverified
detail: Reviewed IE3500 data sheet, CV 5.6.x release notes, current sensor support, preparation and configuration-example guides. These establish IOx/platform and network prerequisites but do not explicitly support Cyber Vision or SEA/SRA simultaneously with Meraki management for an exact PID/release/license. The combination remains not yet verified.

title: Lifecycle not independently checked
detail: Official lifecycle milestones cover 12 of the 53 exact PIDs; lifecycle remains not yet verified for the other 41. A current data sheet, an ordering-table entry or the absence of a public EoL notice does not prove active sale status. EoX integration is optional future work.
resolution: Phase B adds exact-PID milestone and migration evidence for selected IE2000/3000/4000/4010/5000 and IR829 variants. Remaining PIDs retain unknown lifecycle; absence of a bulletin is not active-sales proof.

title: Exact-version security support matrices still needed
detail: Platform-level hosting statements and commercial bundles do not prove a deployable PID/version/license combination. Cyber Vision and SEA support remain conditional; omitted platforms and comparison-table dashes remain unknown.
resolution: CV 5.6.x release notes now constrain selected hardware to documented firmware trains and IE3300 memory/VID prerequisites. Exact licensing, revision and management coexistence gaps remain visible.

title: CV 5.6 IR8300 row has two firmware conditions
detail: The product cell says running IOS XE 17.15.x with at least 3 GB allocated to IOx; the supported-release cell says minimum 17.9.x. Both statements are preserved and the assertion is flagged for human review; compatibility is displayed as not yet verified pending clarification.

title: Wireless ordering needs concrete mode/domain evidence
detail: Ordering tables contain x-domain templates plus AP/WGB/URWB variants. Family-level wireless references are available, but no mode/domain concatenations have been promoted to source-reviewed exact PIDs.

title: Separate IE9300 Heavy Duty identity not located
detail: The checked official portfolio lists IE9300 Rugged. A distinct Heavy Duty exact-PID ordering source was not located; this is an unresolved research target, not a declaration that it does not exist.

title: SEA-to-SRA rename is not an updated compatibility matrix
detail: The April 2026 SEA data sheet documents separate-agent coexistence limits. CV 5.6.x in October renames SEA to SRA. Do not assume this renaming changes licenses or establishes current SRA deployment/agent compatibility; older separate-agent limits are scoped to that architecture.
